body:
This PR looks a little cleaner, but I'm worried it is a little less robust than https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107699.

Doc regen/load (for native and script classes) happens in a couple of different awkward places (I believe somewhere in GDExtension-world too), so having the checks inside `EditorHelp` makes it a bit more fool-proof, IMO.
 
This PR is using `EditorNode::cmdline_mode`, which is set on `export_preset()` or if there's no available `DisplayServer`, as opposed to `main.cpp::cmdline_tool` from the other PR, which is set for specific command-line options.

Both approaches leave me worried that they might stop docload/docgen when it is desired. For example, wouldn't we want docs loaded with `--doctool`? That sets `main.cpp::cmdline_tool = true`, and I'm guessing it would make `cmdline_mode = true` as well.

Seems to be working fine.

> This PR looks a little cleaner, but I'm worried it is a little less robust than https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107699.

It should be sufficient.
